GOOD TO KNOW

Questions? We've got you.

Everything to know before you choose your Blendr.

What's the difference between the sets?+

Each set contains the same Blendr bottle blender. The Pair includes two bottles and the Trio includes three, at a lower total than buying the same number separately.

Can I mix colors in a bundle?+

Yes. Select Soft Pink or Warm Ivory separately for each bottle before adding your set to the bag.

How big is Blendr?+

It holds 350 ml and measures 82 × 82 × 218 mm. The listed product weight is 490 g.

Can I make smoothies and protein shakes?+

Blendr is designed for quick drinks with fruit, liquid and mix-ins. Cut firm ingredients into small pieces and add enough liquid to help the blend.

How do I clean it?+

Rinse the cup soon after use and follow the care instructions supplied with your unit. Keep the charging contact dry.

What comes with the recipe gift?+

A digital eBook with 50 juice and smoothie recipe ideas is included with any bottle set.

Do you ship worldwide?+

Yes, worldwide delivery is planned. Your shipping options, estimated time and any charges will be shown at checkout before payment.

When will I see shipping and payment details?+

We plan to ship worldwide. Available destinations, delivery costs and estimated times will be shown at checkout before an order is placed.
